brief: Landing page for Ledgerline, a 13-week cash forecast for e-commerce brands doing $10M to $200M on Shopify and Amazon. It pulls payouts, ad spend, purchase orders and loan schedules into one forecast, flags the week cash dips below a floor the brand sets, and suggests moves (delay a purchase order, draw on the credit line, shift ad budget). The company is fictional.

Landing page for Tallow, contract review for in-house legal teams of two to ten lawyers. It checks third-party paper against the team's playbook, returns tracked changes in Word with the rule behind each one, and tracks renewal and notice dates after signature. The company is fictional.

Landing page for Northbound, dispatch software for electric truck fleets of 20 to 500 trucks. It plans each trip around battery range, charger availability and driver hours, books charging bays ahead, and reroutes in real time when a charger queue grows. The company is fictional.

Landing page for Marrow, scheduling for independent physiotherapy clinics with one to six practitioners. It fills cancelled slots from a waitlist by text message, takes deposits, and shows each practitioner's week with rooms and equipment. The company is fictional.

Home page for Oda & Finch, a two-person furniture studio in Lisbon that makes about thirty pieces a year to order in oak and cork. Visitors should see the work first, understand lead times of ten to fourteen weeks, and be able to enquire about a commission. The studio is fictional; use license-clear photographs as stand-ins and list them as assumed.
